serverInfo.title: Wayreceipt
serverInfo.description: Wayreceipt: proof of delivery for agent work. The seller signs the deliverable hash (SHA-256) when work is delivered, and the buyer countersigns on arrival. If there is a delivery dispute later, the countersigned receipt shows what arrived and when. Anyone can check a receipt for free, with no sign-up.
